lines.en: I have to tie my shoes, so you go ahead.
You guys, I'm telling you, when she runs,
she looks like a cross between Kermit the Frog
Monica had such a crush on him
that she used to kiss his poster every night
Oh! I used to do that, too!
Did you also have his album, "It's Not Easy Being Green"?
And I know she's gonna want to run again.
I just don't know how to get out of it.
I mean, I live with her.
Why don't you just be straight with her?
You're right. I should just tell her the truth.
I don't think I can ever run again. Ever.
Why? Why would you do that?
Rachel, I'm sorry that I hurt your ankles.
I saw you grab your running shoes this morning
You lied so you could run by yourself.
No, I was -- No, you know what?
I was -- I was actually just checking to see if I could run.
Can I talk to you for a second?
I just wanted to say that I'm sorry, okay?
I handled the situation horribly, and -- and I should not have lied to you.
So, what should you have done?
Well, I -- I should have told you the truth.
Well, you know, the reason that I didn't want to go running with you is because, um --
Well, you know, the way that you run is just a little --
People were looking at us like we were crazy.
But people that you don't know and will never see again.
Yes, but still, they are people with eyes.
Well, I didn't get embarrassed running next to Miss --
No, no, I can see why running with me would be embarrassing to you.
I run like I did when I was a kid.
Because it's the only way it's fun.
I mean, didn't you ever run so fast you thought your legs were gonna fall off?
Like when you were, like, running toward the swings or running away from Satan?
